name: NUN KOMM, DER HEIDEN HEILAND

reviewNotes: Held back: the score gives no year for the words; not provably public domain: "textPublished" must be a year before 1929. Imported from the Open Hymnal Project's ABC score; check the notes and the words against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. Line breaks in the words are worked out from the syllables and punctuation; check them against a hymn book. The last 2 verses are printed after the score in the source, not under the notes. The Open Hymnal's own source: "Mehrstimmiges ChoralBuch", 1906 Hymn #135, page 109 Ed. Karl Brauer. slightly altered. Music source: The Evangelical Lutheran Hymn Book, 1931, Hymn 141.
